questions.q: According to this lesson, why does it carry PowerShell, Python, and Bash CLI scripting instead of recommending just one tool?
options: Each tool is genuinely the best fit for a different kind of automation task, so recognizing which fits the job matters more than picking one favorite
PowerShell cannot run on any platform other than Windows Server
Python is strictly faster than both PowerShell and Bash in every case
Cloud providers require all three tools to be used together
questions.explain: The lesson's core point is that there's no single winner — experienced administrators choose the tool that fits the task.

questions.q: What makes PowerShell a strong fit for Windows-heavy, Azure-heavy shops specifically?
options: The Az module gives nearly every Azure operation a native cmdlet, and it follows the same Verb-Noun pattern already taught
PowerShell is the only language that can call any cloud API
PowerShell scripts run faster than Python scripts in all circumstances
The Az module eliminates the need for authentication
questions.explain: The Az module's cmdlet coverage and the familiar Verb-Noun pattern make PowerShell a natural fit when the environment is already Windows and Azure.

questions.q: When does Python earn its place over PowerShell or CLI scripting, according to this lesson?
options: When a task needs to run cross-platform, involves genuinely complex logic, or needs a library beyond what cloud SDKs offer
Only when working exclusively with AWS and never Azure
Only for tasks that involve no APIs whatsoever
Python is never a better choice than PowerShell for any cloud task
questions.explain: Python's strengths are cross-platform support, handling complex logic, and access to libraries beyond cloud SDKs.

questions.q: Why might a short Bash script calling the az or aws CLI be a better choice than PowerShell or Python for a simple task?
options: There's no module to import or SDK syntax to look up — it's just the CLI commands you'd type by hand, saved to a file
Bash scripts are the only option that can run on Azure
Bash is required for all infrastructure automation by industry standard
PowerShell cannot call the az or aws CLI at all
questions.explain: For simple, sequential CLI tasks, Bash scripting avoids the overhead of a module or SDK and is often the fastest to write and read.

questions.q: What makes a Bash CLI script the most portable of the three options this lesson discusses?
options: It runs the same way on Linux, a Mac laptop, or WSL on Windows with nothing extra installed beyond the CLI itself
It automatically converts itself into PowerShell when run on Windows
It requires installing the full Python SDK first
It can only run inside the Azure portal's Cloud Shell
questions.explain: A Bash script using the CLI needs only the CLI itself, which makes it portable across operating systems without extra setup.
